name: Nymphs Sprite
description: Sprite Foundry-inspired 8-direction sprite pipeline module for NymphsCore, targeting Z-Image Turbo with a compatible sprite LoRA.

manager_action_groups.title: Model Fetch
manager_action_groups.description: Download everything Sprite needs from one dropdown. The complete stack fetches the shared Z-Image INT4 r32 backend through Nymphs Image's cache plus Sprite's LoRAs, staged ControlNet Union, and Depth Anything assets. Hugging Face models use the same shared cache as Nymphs Image, TRELLIS, and Pixal3D; Sprite LoRAs publish into the LoRA module's shared $HOME/LoRA/loras library.

overview.body: Initial Nymphs Sprite scaffold. Targets Z-Image Turbo through Nymphs Image with a Z-Image-compatible sprite LoRA, Z-Image ControlNet Union, and Depth Anything, while keeping Sprite Foundry's ComfyUI workflow contract as reference material for parity.

dependencies.zimage: Required generation backend for Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo and Z-Image Turbo LoRA loading.
dependencies.depth_anything: depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf for depth references and derived depth maps.
dependencies.nymphscore: Target orchestration layer for replacing the captured ComfyUI workflow behavior.
dependencies.comfyui: Optional reference runtime only while parity work is in progress.

notes: Initial scaffold captures Sprite Foundry ComfyUI workflow templates, Z-Image Turbo request profiles, pixel-art LoRA candidates, Z-Image ControlNet Union, Depth Anything, a sprite-specific Manager UI, and the NymphsCore module contract.

The direction runner calls Nymphs Image /generate with the chosen Z-Image Turbo LoRA. ControlNet and Depth Anything fetch/status surfaces are first-class; selected source images now flow through Z-Image Nunchaku controlnet_edit when used as guidance.
v0.1.1 writes Sprite Foundry-style batch artifacts: copied direction images, sprite_batch.json, and an optional contact sheet when Pillow is available.
v0.1.2 ports the MIT-licensed Sprite Foundry post-processing method and exposes --sprite-size from 24 to 512 pixels, defaulting to 96 for Z-Image detail retention.
v0.1.3 fixes the default mks0813 LoRA filename, emits standard MODEL FETCH progress, reports downloaded sprite assets in status, and adds module-owned LoRA weight deletion.
v0.1.4 consolidates LoRA, ControlNet, and Depth downloads into one module-owned Asset Fetch dropdown.
v0.1.5 makes Complete Sprite Package fetch both LoRAs, with mks0813 selected by default until the UI exposes LoRA switching.
v0.1.6 routes Asset Fetch through the existing fetch_lora capability so older Manager sessions do not grey out the submit button.
v0.1.7 rebuilds the module-owned UI from the Nymphs Image rail/stage pattern, with a generated sprite preview, contact-sheet thumbnails, compact status, and no dashboard-card layout.

v0.1.8 removes asset download controls from the custom generation UI, keeps asset fetch in the module detail action group, adds run-level downloaded-LoRA selection, and restores the Nymphs Image strip organizer/folder picker pattern.
v0.1.9 adds a sprite prompt preset dropdown, separates source-image generation from generate-and-process, and removes the always-visible log from the UI stage.

v0.1.10 replaces the starter prompt presets with Sprite Foundry-derived subjects, inlines the Nymphs Image forest background during install, moves source generation into the Z-Image stage, and lets the strip picker load recent Z-Image outputs.
v0.1.11 keeps the forest background as an installed file URI instead of a huge data URI so WebView2 can load the module UI.
v0.1.12 base64url-chunks long prompt, LoRA trigger/path, and selected source-image arguments so Manager's safe module-action argument filter does not reject generation.
v0.1.13 rewires source generation to call Z-Image /generate directly like Nymphs Image, leaving Manager module actions for status, folders, and Foundry-style post-processing.
v0.1.14 replaces the small hand-written prompt sample with a generated Sprite Foundry character preset catalog and aligns source prompt composition with the Foundry NymphsCore runner.
v0.1.15 adds module actions for the canonical Sprite Foundry fork flow, including Foundry status/verify and generate-nymphscore from imported presets.

v0.1.16 adds a Sprite-facing Model Fetch action that delegates to the shared Nymphs Image / Z-Image fetcher and cache before first run, and leaves the Nunchaku-compatible tarn59 LoRA selected after complete fetches.
v0.1.17 rebuilds the prompt preset catalog from the original 92-entry Foundry export roster only and moves staged ControlNet/Depth downloads onto the shared Hugging Face cache.
v0.1.18 loads the selected Z-Image INT4 r32 model before Sprite generation and falls back from stale mks0813 LoRA selection to the runtime-compatible tarn59 LoRA when available.
v0.1.19 switches Sprite LoRA fetches to the LoRA module's shared $HOME/LoRA/loras layout, uses the corrected mks0813/z-image-turbo-pixel-lora repo, and adds SkyAsl/Pixel-artist-Z alongside tarn59.

v0.1.20 normalizes fetched Z-Image LoRA key prefixes for Nunchaku, resolves stale legacy selected-LoRA paths to the shared LoRA library before generation, and keeps the Foundry bridge on the same selected LoRA path contract.
v0.1.21 adds the Sprite UI Z-Image model/rank selector and normalizes shared-LoRA dropdown labels/triggers for mks0813, SkyAsl, and tarn59, including custom-discovered shared library paths.
v0.1.22 keeps all three canonical Sprite LoRA candidates visible in the UI and marks missing shared-library files instead of hiding absent candidates from the dropdown.
v0.1.23 makes the generation bridges prefer the resolved shared LoRA library path over stale legacy UI arguments so old nymphs-sprite LoRA paths cannot override the selected shared LoRA.

v0.1.24 makes the Sprite generation UI rank-only with r32, r128, and r256, restores the Nymphs Image-style strip browser/forest preview, and keeps hardware-specific INT4/FP4 choices in the Manager model fetch page.
v0.1.25 restarts and reloads the shared Z-Image backend once when a stale Nunchaku transformer rank causes a qkv_proj_down LoRA shape mismatch during source generation.

v0.1.26 aligns Sprite's Z-Image model choices, selected LoRA path precedence, LoRA strength default, and generate payload with the working Nymphs Image UI contract: auto_r32, auto_r128, int4_r256, no Sprite-owned rank-mismatch restart.

v0.1.27 removes Sprite's source-generation module bridge action from the manifest and custom UI path. The Manager Generate Sources button now only uses the direct Nymphs Image-style Z-Image /generate flow, with Fast 512 defaults and one front source selected by default for smoke testing.

v0.1.28 restores generate_sources as the local_html Manager transport while keeping the shared Nymphs Image/Z-Image runtime, venv, model cache, and LoRA library. Sprite no longer browser-fetches the Z-Image API directly from its local_html UI.

v0.1.29 flushes Sprite bridge progress immediately and merges Z-Image JSON preview URLs back onto their local output paths so source generation feels less frozen and the strip does not show duplicate blank tiles.
v0.1.30 restores the Nymphs Image forest stage background in Sprite by simplifying the viewer CSS to use the installed local forest PNG directly instead of the darker overlay/fallback stack.
v0.1.31 embeds the forest PNG into the installed local_html UI and makes the Recent strip proxy Nymphs Image /api/outputs with a filesystem fallback over the shared Z-Image output folders.
v0.1.32 wires selected/generated source images into Z-Image Nunchaku controlnet_edit so Generate + Process can run guided direction generation through ControlNet.
